In the AFDK 2025 documentation, the concept of a "coding assignment" refers to the specific methodological mapping of registry codes or databases to clinical quality indicators. The available evidence details a single, specific coding assignment: the [[bfkb|BFKB]] code is explicitly designated to serve as the numerator (tæller) for the calculation of [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] [^src1]. 

Because the provided corpus contains only this single data point regarding coding assignments, no broader context, chronological history, or additional indicator mappings are available for this topic. The documentation strictly limits its mention of this assignment to the definitional parameters of Indikator 8.

## Claims

- BFKB-koden anvendes som tæller for indikator 8 [^src1] (bfkb, indikator-8)
  - Type: coding-assignment
  - Page: 96
  - Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 96-98
